text_block_list.text:
I ended up being invited alongside Kawakami Princess
to a party hosted by an acquaintance of King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
O-Ooh...! So this is what a first-class party is like, is it?!
W-What a magnificent venue and food...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Are you all right, Kawakami-san?
Do you remember the first thing you're supposed to do when coming to a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, o-of course!
Um, if I recall, uh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! We must secure the most delicious
dishes before anyone else takes them!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, you don't! Greet the host first!
We went over this properly before coming here, didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh!
choice_data_list: Now, now, don't be so harsh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You can't baby her!
I know she's nervous, but Kawakami-san is the one who'll end up embarrassing herself, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, pull yourself together and greet them! I'll be right by your side, so stand tall!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-Ye~s...!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! If it isn't King-chan!?
Man, it's been ages! So great to see you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite a while, Uncle.
This is my classmate—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
G-Good day and nice to meet you!
I am Kawakami Princess!
I'm counting on you, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Fuhahaha, it's good to see you full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? I did it!
King-san coached me on this!
She told me to greet people briskly and with a clear, carrying voice—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, setting that aside for now—
Uncle, I heard you worked with my mother the other day...

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. No, she's a world-class designer for a reason.
Her work the other day was absolute perfection.
Seriously, I can't thank her enough.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, my mother is the one who's always so grateful for—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Aah!? I just had a flash of inspiration!
Speaking of people who look after others, King-san
takes great care of me all the time too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: !? K-Kawakami-san—?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"But when I broke my eighteenth teacup the other day, she finally snapped at me.
'Clean it up yourself!' she said..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Allow me to deliver my ultimate Princess Joke! What do an angry King-san and an often clumsy me have in common?"

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Oho, and what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Both mean “hectic”, don't they!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ......O-Ohohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —What on earth are you doing?!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeeh~!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, we're lucky they were forgiving...
Depending on the situation, that could've gotten you kicked out on the spot!"
choice_data_list: She's giving it her all in her own way, so...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That was like taking a 100 mph fastball straight to the body!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't be mad~...!
I just thought it was the perfect chance to drop a witty princess joke...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, ah!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What? Did you think of something we could improve on?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Umm, so... speaking of the wonderful steak
we just had at the venue, and a furious King-san
boiling over right now...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Both mean “hot”, don't they!
How about something like this!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't clever at all!!
Kawakami-san, over here right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaaa!?
I'm so terribly sorry wa~!!
—It seems the day Kawakami Princess learns to act like a true princess at parties is still a long way off—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "That's right! I'll just have to personally drill it into you properly this time!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I studied so hard for the party...
I studied the art of witty conversation and everything...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You should have spent that time
studying etiquette instead..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
True, being able to crack a little joke in a place like that
is important, but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Then I was completely right!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No way, absolutely not!
Why am I the punchline in the first place?!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek...!

—And so, Kawakami Princess ended up taking
joke lessons from King Halo three times a week—
